content: The filtration process is automatic and fully unsupervised since the original documents have no ground-truth labels for fine-grained law articles, and coarse-grained law-articles only provide limited information. We also experiment with the ground-truth articles, but only a small fraction of them has fine-grained ones, and they are usually not available in real-world scenarios.
